display_name: Renters' Rights Act 2025 (UK) under one top-level goal — periodic tenancies and permitted rent periods (HA 1988 s 4A), rent in advance and the substitute rent day (s 4B, TFA Sch 1 para 1(1A)), and rental bidding penalties (ss 56-57) — and those three goals

others: fixed-term or period terms are of no effect in (rra-tenancy.l4)
the rent periods are permitted in (rra-tenancy.l4)
the term for rent due in advance is of no effect for … in (rra-tenancy.l4)
the day the rent is due for … in (rra-tenancy.l4)
a payment of rent on … is prohibited for (rra-tenancy.l4)
a rental bidding penalty may be imposed for (rra-bidding.l4)
an additional penalty may be imposed on … after (rra-bidding.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: HA 1988 ss 4A(1)-(3), (5), (8) and 4B(1)-(7), (12) as inserted, TFA 2019 Sch 1 para 1(1A) as inserted, and ss 56, 57(1)-(4), (9) of the revised text as at 22 June 2026. The s 4A(6) formula is lost in conversion. Left out on purpose: grounds and s 8, rent increases, pets, discrimination, database and ombudsman, penalty procedure, Welsh and Scottish provisions.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 80 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); none failed. Dates are computed as the Act words them, with no working-day rule. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: s 4A(3): 28 days permitted, 29 not; monthly is an input category.
forks.F2: Initial rent: first period, or a later one ending by first day + 27.
forks.F3: Permitted pre-tenancy period: entry day to the day before the first day.
forks.F4: Due in advance: before the period's first day.
forks.F5: Substitute rent day: regular rent day (input), else the period's first day.
forks.F6: s 57(2): previous penalty after the corresponding date five years earlier and on or before the new date.
forks.F7: Every assured tenancy within s 4A runs as periodic; transitional cases not separated.
